translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Romagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Romanos

content: Pablo gwenadganga sogsiid, bemar nued sogeye
Anmar-buna-Febe, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-Cencreagi-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-bendakedga gudiid. An bemarga soge,

a-buna Bab-Jesús-nuggi be nue abingamalo, igi Jesucristogi-akananaimalad gusgu-igar-maidba nued abingalegedyob. Degine, ibi-ibmar Febe abealile, bemar bendakmalo, ar ade we-ome dulemar-bukidar-bendaksad, degine, anse-bakar an-bendaksamogad.
Priscila, degi, Aquila, amar anba Cristo-Jesúsga-arbamalad gumalad, amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Wemar an-ular burgwednaga gusmalad. Amarga anbi dog-nuedye an sogsulid, bela Judiosurmalad Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad dog-nuedye Priscilaga, degi, Aquilaga sogmarmogad.
Degine, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-amar-neggi-danar-ambikunoni-damaladga be sogbalo, bemar nued sogeye. Degine, Epeneto, an nue sabed, we insale Acayagi Cristoba-nagus-gusad, aga sogbalo, be nued sogeye.
María, bemar-abargi nue arbasad, aga sogbalo, be nued sogeye.

Andrónico, degine, Junias, an-gwenadgan, degine, anmar-dare eskaryagi mellesii-gusad. Gwenadgan-Jesús-nuggi-barmilearmalad we-a-dulemar-warbogwad nue-egi-binsaed-nikaa damarmogad, degine, we-gwenadgan-inse an-idu Cristo-abingas-gusmalad. Amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Amplias, nue Bab-Jesús-nuggi an sabedid, aga sogo, be nued sogeye.
Urbano, Cristo-Jesúsgi anmarba arbaed, degine, Estaquis, an nue sabed, amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Apeles, Cristogi nue bensuli na oyosad, a-dulega sogo, be nued sogeye. Aristóbulo-negginmaladga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
An-gwenad-Herodiónga sogo, be nued sogeye. Narciso-negginmalad Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad, amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Trifena, degine, Trifosa, amar Bab-Jesúsga-arbamalad gumalad. Amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye. Pérsida, Bab-Jesús-igargi nue arbasmogad, a anmar nue sabmalad, aga sogmogo, be nued sogeye.
Rufo, Bab-Jesús na susad, Bab-Jesúsgi nue nug nikamogad, degine, a-e-nan, an-nanyobi an dakmogad, amarga sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Asíncrito, Flegonte, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, degine, gwenadgan-amarba-gudimaladga sogo, bemar nueganbimar sogeye.
Filólogo, Julia, Nereo, Nereo-e-bun, Olimpas, degine, bela Jesucristogi-akananaimalad-amarba-gudimaladga sogo, bemar nueganbi sogeye.
Na be nue-angaagwaledgi na be muchub-muchub sogmar, na be nued sogeye. Bela Cristoba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad bemarga sogsiid, bemar nued sogeye.
Pablo gwenadgan napi unasiid

Gwenadgan, wesikdi an bemarga soged, nue salakarmar, dulemar-danar-danar-sordamar-gamaladgi, degine, Bab-Jesús-igar-banguega dulemar-imakedgi, ar bemar ibmar-durdaksad weyob durdaksasurmalad. A-dulemargi bemar bangumar.

Ar dule-degi-damalad we anmar-Dummad-Jesucristoga arbadisurmalad, wedi e-sabangi-binsaedba arbamalad, degine, binnaa sunmakedgine, degine, yamo-binsa-nued-sunmakedgine, dulemar-binsaedsurmalad binsaed-gaddamalad.

Ar ade bemar Bab-Jesús-sogedba-ibsaedi bela dulemar be wisgumamaid, degisoggu, bemarba weligwar an itosundo. Degisoggu, ibmar-nuedgala bemar binsaed-nikaa-gubi an abedo, ibmar-iskanagardi baisur-binsaed.

Degine, Bab-Dummad-ulubgi-bogidik-itogega-anmar-imaked, a emiskwasaar nia-saila-Satanásgi-nakwed be-imakmaloed, bemar be-naggi nia-saila-birgi annasayobi be gumaloed. Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo bitigi nued bemargi binsamalana-gadin.
Timoteo-anbo-arbaed, Lucio, Jasón, degine, Sosípater, an-gwenadgan, amar bemarga sogsiid, bemar nued sogeye.
Ani Tercio, we garda an-googi an bemarga narmaksad, Bab-Jesús-nuggi an bemarga soged, bemar nued sogeye.

Gayo, e-neggi an-ogabed, degine, bela Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, amar bela bemarga sogmarmogad, bemar nued sogeye. Erasto, neggweburga-mani-saboged-dule, degine, gwenad-Cuarto bemarga sogsimogad, bemarde nueganbi sogeye.
Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo bitigi nued bela bemargi binsamalana-gadin. Ar deyobdo.
Pablo napi Bab-Dummad-nug ogannoged
Emigi Bab-Dummad-nug ogannomarsun, ar Bab Dummad sunna gandik bemar-imaked, an gaya-burba-nued Jesucristogi an sunmakdiidyob. We-igarde iduar gusgu gebe-negasailaunni odukuar mainad.

Emigindi we-igar-osanalenonikid. Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Bab-Dummad-geg-bergued-sogsadba narmaksamalad, adi bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad Jesucristogi mer bengumalagar, eba uaya-nikaa damalagar.
Ar unnila Bab Dummadbi wargwennagwad, degine, bela-ibmar-wisi maid, a-e-nug Jesucristoba, degi-sadegu ogannomarsun. Be itomargua.
